products.title: Half Moon Cast Iron Plancha Griddle (Large, XL, 2XL)
products.body_html:
Every coin has two sides. The same goes for the Half Cast Iron Plancha Griddle. The ridged side is excellent for fish fillets or hot sandwiches, while the smooth side is perfect for frying eggs, blinis, or pancakes. Since this cast iron griddle only covers half of the grate in your Big Green Egg, you still have room to grill.

The best way to start your day? A breakfast cooked on the Big Green Egg! Eggs, bacon, pork, sausages, sautéed tomatoes, mushrooms, and a stack of American pancakes served with blueberries. With the Half Cast Iron Plancha Griddle, you can serve all of this in no time.

products.title: Pizza Oven Wedge for Large Egg
products.body_html:
Transform your egg into a pizza oven with these precision-engineered aluminum wedges. Creating a front-loading aperture, they enable effortless insertion and monitoring of pizzas up to 14 inches (36 cm) in diameter. The wedges work in harmony with the egg's ceramic insulation to maintain consistent temperatures between 400°F to 700°F (204°C to 370°C), ensuring perfectly crisp crusts and melted toppings. Seamlessly integrated with the eggspander system, these wedges unlock new culinary possibilities for your outdoor cooking repertoire.

  • Cast aluminum construction for durability and heat conductivity
  • Compatible with 14-inch (36 cm) pizzas
  • Temperature range: 400°F to 700°F (204°C to 370°C)
  • Hand wash only

products.title: Rib/Roast Rack - Stainless (2XL, XL, L, M, S)
products.body_html:
The Multifunctional Ribs and Roasting Rack is perfect for cooking a large roast. The stand is a V-rack: it fits large pieces of meat or (stuffed) poultry that need to be cooked slowly. When you turn the rack over, it's perfect for cooking ribs. The constant airflow around the Ribs and Roasting Rack provides fantastic results. A must-have for all meat lovers.

You can also use the Ribs and Roasting Rack as a resting shelf for even juicier meat. Tip! Combine the rack with the matching Rectangular Drip Pan. This catches the meat juices and gives you a nice base for making a good gravy. The V-rack can hold a roast of about 5 kg.

products.title: Cast Iron Dual Side Plancha Griddle 10.5 in / 27 cm (2XL, XL, L, M, S, MX)
products.body_html:
The Big Green Egg 10.5 in / 27 cm Dual-Sided Cast Iron Plancha Griddle is perfect for adding sear marks and a delicious flavor-packed crust to foods. This new size will fit perfectly in the MiniMax EGG on up! Big Green Egg cast iron products are built to deliver a lifetime of cooking enjoyment. You can use in your EGG for everything from blackened chicken and seafood, to grilled vegetables and steakhouse-style seared steaks. 

  • The ridged side is great for adding sear marks to food, or for roasting pork chops, hot dogs, chicken, asparagus and green beans.
  • Use the smooth side to grill breakfast pancakes, omelets and hash browns. Drip channel to keep juices from falling on the charcoal.
  • High quality casting
  • Pre-seasoned with food-safe vegetable oil
  • The four tabs are designed to be compact yet provide easy handling for either orientation
  • Exclusive Big Green Egg design – EGG molded under each tab
  • Designed to pair with the 10.5 in / 27 cm Cast Iron Skillet (Item: 120144, sold separately) to form a Dutch oven for the smaller EGG sizes.
  • Size 10.5 in / 27 cm

products.title: Cast Iron Dual Side Plancha Griddle 14 in / 36 cm (2XL, XL, L)
products.body_html:
The dual-sided design of the 14 in / 36 cm Cast Iron Plancha Griddle is ideal for searing meats and seafood with a flavor-packed crust, sautéing vegetables and even grilling sandwiches and paninis. Featuring four convenient handles for safe and easy lifting, the Plancha Griddle is also perfect for cooking your breakfast favorites … use the flat side for pancakes and eggs, the ridged side for sausage and bacon. Authentic, high temperature “steak house” grilling is quick, easy and delicious! 
 
  • The Cast Iron Plancha Griddle is ideal for searing meats & seafood with a flavor-packed crust, sautéing vegetables and even grilling sandwiches and paninis.
  • CARE: Clean with soap and water before first use. Soap is not recommended after initial cleaning - hand wash with a brush and water only, dry immediately and lightly coat with cooking oil after each use. Never wash cast iron in the dishwasher.
  • Use with the 2XLarge, XLarge and Large EGG

products.title: convEGGtor® Basket for 2XL EGG (use with 2 Half Moon convEGGtor for 2XL)
products.body_html:
The Big Green Egg 2XL is a versatile outdoor cooker that offers exceptional cooking capabilities. This innovative outdoor cooker features a dual-zone metal and ceramic convEGGtor system, enabling seamless transitions between direct and indirect cooking methods. The redesigned convEGGtor combines a sturdy basket with two half baking stones, offering precise temperature control across an expansive 672 square inch (4,335 cm²) cooking surface. Grill, smoke, roast, bake, and sear with professional-grade results, all within a single, elegantly engineered unit.

The 2XL's convEGGtor system revolutionizes outdoor cooking:

  • Cooking area: 672 sq in (4,335 cm²)

This advanced cooking system harnesses the power of social proof, with top chefs and culinary enthusiasts worldwide embracing its capabilities. The limited availability of the 2XL model creates a sense of scarcity, making it a coveted addition to any outdoor kitchen. By investing in this premium cooker, you're not just buying a grill – you're joining an exclusive community of passionate outdoor cooking enthusiasts.
